text:
Jordan Grimmer-Tufik 

Hi Jordan - I am a Brazilian living/working in the UK and my husband is in Israel. We submitted our documents last week while my husband was visiting me in London. Is that an issue? 

I was not at all aware of the application being paused while the Israeli is abroad 😖 While I wait for the invitation, the plan is for him to either come to London or for us to meet in a third location. 

Are there any rules on how long or how much the Israeli can be abroad while the process is on going? I am scared now that they might just not follow up on our case if they happen to check it while my husband is visiting me abroad. 

Thanks for the help!
